name: maplibrex-demo-assets
description: Front-end dependencies for the MaplibreX demo application

comments.dependencies: MaplibreX declares these as peer dependencies and marks them external in its bundle, so the host application owns the version. The @deck.gl/* packages are only needed because this demo uses <.deckgl_layer>.
comments.maplibrex: Defaults to the Elixir dependency checkout at deps/maplibrex. When MAPLIBREX_PATH points at a local library checkout, `mix assets.setup` installs from there with --no-save, leaving this entry untouched.
comments.maplibre-gl: Pinned to v5 because this demo showcases <.deckgl_layer>. MaplibreX itself supports >=5 <7; deck.gl is the only component that still needs v5, because @deck.gl/mapbox reads the internal map.transform that maplibre-gl v6 removed.
